summary: State-run 48-ft steel tower on Reservoir Hill, first operated 1911 and staffed until 1938; removed after a land dispute; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as a former site; the register says the tower was forced to be removed after a dispute with the landowner.

events.note: Town of Plymouth operated a 90-ft iron fire tower on Billington Hill (predecessor, not this site).
State builds a new tower on Reservoir Hill when it takes over fire detection; FFLOS says first operated in 1911.
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 3, 2008.

notes_for_editor: FFLOS and NHLR agree on the 1911 state-built tower on Reservoir Hill. Neither gives a removal year. NHLR describes a replacement 48-ft tower moved to Telegraph Hill in 1939 without naming which tower it replaced, so this record does not link the Reservoir Hill tower to Plymouth Tower Site #3; do not assume they are the same structure. No source read describes the Reservoir Hill site today or its access. The story now names NHLR as the source of the five-locations count, which FFLOS does not give. Brief record (gone, 290 ft / 88 m, coordinates, 2008 registration) matches FFLOS; no corrections proposed.
